streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

model: At output frame n in [45,75], p=(n-45)/30, incoming inside a centered pixel-space circle of radius p*sqrt(width^2+height^2)/2, outgoing elsewhere. Strict radial < comparison. A/B calibrated from native first/last frame.
limits: Native encoded RGB; interior and all pixels retained separately. Same-UV model includes nonuniform grids, unlike uniform red/blue-only test.
